# Universal Health Services, Inc. Recognized With 2026 Staritas Supply Chain Excellence Award


Medium-GettyImages-1778307373


Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS) has been named a recipient of the **2026 Staritas Supply Chain Excellence Award** . The recognition honors healthcare organizations demonstrating strong performance in supply chain management and the use of data, benchmarking and market intelligence to improve decision-making.


The award reflects the growing strategic role of healthcare supply chain teams in identifying opportunities, understanding market variation and supporting informed clinical, operational and financial decisions.


“This recognition reflects the work our supply chain team does every day to bring greater visibility, discipline and insight to complex purchasing decisions,” said Raymond Davis, Vice President of Supply Chain, UHS. “We’re proud of the team and the impact this work has across our organization.”


## About the Recognition


The 2026 Staritas Supply Chain Excellence Award recognizes healthcare organizations demonstrating strong supply chain performance and the use of data and market intelligence to identify opportunities, benchmark spending and support strategic sourcing and purchasing decisions across areas such as medical supplies, capital equipment, physician preference items, service contracts and reagents.
